description:
[read-only] Posting (drip) queues of one brand. A queue posts one item every cadenceHours at timeOfDay in its timezone, keeping `lookahead` items booked at the platform.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/queues.)

brandId.description: Account-wide keys: "personal" or an id from GET /api/v2/brands (omitted → the brand last active in the dashboard; required once the account is in more than one organization). A brand-bound key always uses its own brand.

cursor.description: The `nextCursor` of the previous page. Omit for the first page.

fields.description: Top-level item fields to return instead of the summary. Default: a summary of each item's plain fields. For one item in full, use the matching get_ tool.

name: list_queues
title: List posting queues
